people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jephthah
people.line: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.

people.name: Tob
people.line: Region where Jephthah fled and recruited mercenaries

translations.web: When the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah out of the land of Tob.
translations.bsb: and made war with them, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob.
translations.kjv: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:
